title: Chapter 440
paragraphs: Chapter 440
127. To the Black King Squad (1)
After the exile's death, there were no people who openly spoke about the matter.
But among the family members, there was an odd atmosphere flowing. It was only natural since there were many questionable aspects of the exile's death.
"Do you think the exile's words were true?"
"What do you mean?"
Two Guardian Knights, who had just finished their duties and started their break, were having a conversation.
"The part where the acting head of the family worried about the 2nd Knight and purged the execution knights at that time."
Upon hearing this, the listening Guardian Knight hesitated and looked around nervously. Talking about the unfavorable aspects of the 2nd Knight could potentially lead to irreversible consequences.
"Be more careful with your words!"
"Nobody's in this backyard at this time. I know, so don't be surprised. The Sword Garden is the most relaxing space, isn't it?"
"That's true, but anyway, since the exile is already dead, we can't know the truth behind his words."
"It was a situation that warranted a thorough investigation, but the 2nd Knight's summary execution feels odd."
Joshua's summary execution seemed like an action to cover up the incident quickly.
"The same goes for the Black Sword Chairman's actions. If he really didn't save the exile, it would have been better to save him somehow and prove his innocence."
The Guardian Knights, who paused their conversation for a moment, seemed to have complicated thoughts.
"...If the exile's words were true. It's hard not to think that the price of long-term dedication to the family is quite cruel. And the acting head of the family hasn't said anything yet."
"There's no guarantee that we won't end up like that someday."
"Well, it's an uncomfortable year-end..."
Thud!
Suddenly, there was a sound of a door opening from the ground. At that sound, the Guardian Knights were startled and took a defensive stance.
The Tona brothers came out of the door that was hidden by dirt. The Guardian Knights couldn't help but become pale in an instant.
"Chung!"
"Chung!"
Seeing the saluting Guardian Knights, the Tona brothers coughed.
"It seems your lives aren't precious to you, talking about such dangerous matters."
"Hey, hey. You guys haven't even been here for two years. Are you so desperate to die?"
"We're sorry!"
The Guardian Knights bowed their heads.
Of course, they didn't know, but there was one fact that all the knights who had been taking a break in this backyard so far were unaware of.
This place was also the most comfortable space in the garden for the Tona brothers.
Tired of Myu and Anne's pressure and repression, the brothers eventually created their own sanctuary in this backyard.
They dug a hole and built a simple underground space with a door, but the Tona brothers gained more harvest than expected here.
Just like now, they could listen to the stories of the family members who visited this backyard without getting bored.

As the Tona brothers pretended to brush off the dirt on their bodies, the Guardian Knights quickly and cautiously approached them. Despite their words, they felt as if the brothers didn't think too poorly of them.
"If it were a lie, there would be no reason for them to risk their lives and come to the Sword Garden, right? How much injustice must they have felt to do so?"
"Huh?"
At Daytona's words, the pupils of the Guardian Knights widened.
"We think the exile's last words are not false."
"That's right, that's right."
The Tona brothers had never participated in a ranking battle before, except for a brief quarrel with Jin during their training days. It was a famous story among the Guardian Knights.
But now, the Tona brothers were openly speaking against the 2nd Knight.
While the Guardian Knights couldn't answer, the brothers spoke again.
"The reason they don't investigate is that the elder brother and the council leader have something to hide."

"And to think they would just leave the body for the dogs to eat. If it weren't for the youngest brother, it really would have happened. He was the only one who went against the elder brother's wishes and took care of the body."
"What do you guys think?"
At Daytona's question, the Guardian Knights felt mortified.
Naturally, they were still newcomers who hadn't decided which 'side' to stand on.
"No, never mind. It seems we've made things awkward for you."
"No, not at all!"
"It's what the youngest brother said."
"The elder brother and the council leader should have kept him alive."
"Aren't you curious why?"
The Guardian Knights couldn't help but nod their heads.
"It's because there's still one more exile who hasn't come to the Sword Garden."

"Rather, if the elder brother or the council leader had not killed the exile this time and somehow captured or brainwashed him, they could have used him as a means to deny the words of the surviving exile who would come later. His name was Lutan Perman, right? He was the captain of the 1st Execution Knight at the time."
Although they felt uneasy throughout, in the end, the Guardian Knights felt a genuinely intense curiosity at that part.
"Is that story true? There's one more person..."
"Shush!"
Heytona covered his and the Guardian Knights' mouths with his index finger, then smiled slyly.
"This is the story we wanted to tell."
"The youngest one is the person who knows the value of loyalty the best. That's why we're also planning to actively participate in the ranking battle with the youngest one."
"So you guys, too."
"It'd be good to think carefully from now on. If you want to receive the proper reward for your shining devotion. That's it for now, go."
"Be careful what you say, wherever you are!"
The Guardian Knights left the backyard with their eyes blinking.
"Shall we stop here for today, Heytona?"
"Let's do that. Everyone's mouths are so heavy; the rumors really don't spread well."
The Tona brothers were deliberately waiting for the Guardian Knights who came to the backyard.
They listened carefully to the conversations inside the den and only approached those who seemed to have doubts about the recent situation.

"The youngest one said so. Everyone is well-trained, so it will take some time for the rumors to spread. Let's wait patiently. There will surely be results. Just like everything the youngest one does."
"When the rumors start to spread, the family members will have no choice but to have doubts. About why the 2nd Knights and some of the council's forces are always looking for something."

As the Lotus, Jin spoke, and everyone's eyes gathered. The gazes of Talaris, who was lying on an ice bed receiving a massage from the golden-footed group, Lutan who was sitting next to him, and Murakan and Siles sitting across.
"When it is revealed that their movement is not to resolve the family's affairs, but to hide another foul smell. Then, both of them will suffer huge damage."
Jin did not intend to end the exile's death with just creating a 'gloomy atmosphere' in the family.
He wanted to shake the entire foundation and standing of the 2nd Knights and the council.
"Huh. The day Lutan dies will be the day the worst scandal in Runcandel's history erupts."

-The 12th Knight is right, but one person must survive. Captain. Please let the captain witness their end. And if the 12th Knight allows it, someday when Runcandel becomes his, please live on behalf of us, who are dead.
Lutan was recalling the last words of the dead exile while touching the sword that Jin brought.
At that time, Lutan wanted to say that he would rather die.
However, he couldn't bring himself to say those words. He knew better than anyone how painful it is to continue living with only hatred after losing everything.
Surviving was the most difficult and heavy task. Lutan survived not as a member, but to bear more responsibility himself.
"... What should I do now?"
Lutan spoke.
"First, recover your body."
After the exile's death, Jin and Lutan used formal language with each other.

Jin had forgiven the attack on Tikan, so it was now right to treat them as Execution Knights, and Lutan had decided to become his sword, so he thought it was appropriate to use the language befitting that.
"Right. I did become too weak. I still seem to be around 9th rank, but I shouldn't have been subdued by you so quickly, right?"
After the council bruised his face and body, Lutan was in a considerably weakened state.
Although he was still at the 9th rank, he was originally the captain of the Execution Knights '1st Division' and the closest person to the Black Knights.
Moreover, he was associated with the Black Knights who were evaluated as the 'strongest in history,' the Black Knights of the Ciron.
If the tragedy hadn't occurred, Lutan could have been a Black Knight.
"I also think I need to recover, but there seems to be no other way."
"You must receive treatment from the Saint King."
"...Saint King?"

"Unless you use the legacy of Numerus, there would be limits even for her. But isn't there no one who can do better treatment than the Saint King? I'll write you a letter, so you should go before the end of this year."
"Even when Mikelan was the Saint King, not even the family head could use him easily. Impressive."
"You must go without being exposed to anyone."
"Of course, that won't be difficult."
"Well, if it's the Saint King's treatment, I'll definitely get better to some extent. Let's regain my old skills and support our son-in-law well, Lutan."
"What happens after the treatment?"
"You will have to become a teacher for my knights."
The youngest division.
Jin planned to entrust their education to Lutan.
"Train them like Execution Knights, without mercy."
The youngest division had to become the center of the knights who would gather around Jin in the future.
In order to do that, they needed to have the skills to match him.
The current youngest division, excluding Velop, Mesa, and Skut, had just average Guardian Knight skills, so they needed to grow quickly.
"Doing so could kill them. Besides, those who have become Guardian Knights from the past don't want to enjoy it once, not to receive new training."
It was only natural for a person to want to be rewarded for a while after going through a terrible process to become a Guardian Knight.
"If there are those who show displeasure, you can just cut them off without reporting to me. But there probably won't be anyone like that."
"Understood. I will go to the Saint King tomorrow, so please send the new recruits immediately, my lord. It would be best to start right away."
"By the way, Jin."
"Yes, Lord Talaris."
"When do you plan to visit the Black King's main residence?"
"I plan to go straight away tomorrow. It would be better to secure the forces to protect Tikan as soon as possible, even if it's just a day earlier."
